text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, what a crowd! Are all these people 
here... for the Oaks?

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it crazier than usual this year? 
Could it be... the "Illustrious Clan"?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Well, of course! Everyone wants to see it.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
—To see the perfect 'Illustrious Family' 
finally crowned Queen of the Oaks!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tokyo Racecourse was already filled with 
immense excitement. The expectations 
riding on her were even greater than at 
the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've been training constantly to bring out 
my best at 2,400 meters, but... in the 
end, I still haven't found the answer.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I head toward the press conference.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby must be feeling that wall as 
well, but—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...I must go.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Fan of the Illustrious Family
text_block_list.text:
Lady Daiichi Ruby! The Oaks is a race 
steeped in your mother's destiny... Please 
avenge her!

text_block_list.name: Fan of the Illustrious Family
text_block_list.text:
We shall bring the long-sought crown... to 
the history of the "Splendid Clan"!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you all for your expectations.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
With a magnificent victory, let us add the 
Oaks trophy to our family's illustrious 
achievements.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
She's so poised and confident... Even with 
all these expectations placed on her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even beneath the ever-mounting pressure, 
she remains unphased. Encouragement and 
validation are surely things she has no 
need for.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —That concludes the final confirmation.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Well then. ...Off to the race.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I'm not quite sure I follow your meaning.
choice_data_list: Your strength is the real deal.
Your strength is the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her flawless run in the Selection Race, 
and the blistering speed she showed in the 
Fillies' Revue... All of it proves just 
how talented she is.
choice_data_list: I want you to believe in yourself
I want you to believe in yourself.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Trusting in this blood that flows within 
me—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not relying on lineage alone, she 
accumulated the necessary effort. When 
talent and hard work unite—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...I take pride in knowing I have done 
what needed to be done.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I will give everything I have right now, 
—and seize victory.
